package fixture

import (
	"io/ioutil" // want
	. "os"      // want
	"os"
	"errors"
	"os/exec"
	"syscall"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

// This file is data for TestOSWriteScannerSelfTest (a .txt file: it is neither
// compiled nor scanned by the rule itself). Every line that must be flagged
// carries the marker "want"; no other line may be flagged.

func bad(p string) {
	_ = os.Rename(p, p+".x")        // want
	_ = os.Remove(p)                // want
	_ = os.RemoveAll(p)             // want
	_ = os.Mkdir(p, 0o700)          // want
	_ = os.MkdirAll(p, 0o700)       // want
	_ = os.MkdirTemp("", "x")       // want
	_ = os.Truncate(p, 0)           // want
	_ = os.Chmod(p, 0o600)          // want
	_ = os.WriteFile(p, nil, 0o600) // want
	_, _ = os.Create(p)             // want
	_, _ = os.OpenFile(p, 0, 0)     // want
	_, _ = os.CreateTemp("", "x")   // want
	_ = os.Symlink(p, p+".l")       // want
	f := os.WriteFile               // want
	_ = f
}

func lowLevel(p string) {
	_, _ = syscall.Open(p, syscall.O_CREAT, 0o600)     // want
	_ = exec.Command("cp", p, p+".x")                  // want
	_, _ = unix.Open(p, unix.O_CREAT, 0o600)           // want
	_ = windows.CreateFile                             // want
	_ = syscall.Unlink(p)                              // want
	var _ syscall.Errno
	_ = errors.Is(nil, syscall.ENAMETOOLONG)
	var st unix.Statfs_t
	_ = unix.Statfs(p, &st)
	_, _ = windows.UTF16PtrFromString(p)
	_ = windows.GetDiskFreeSpaceEx
}

func good(p string) {
	f, err := os.Open(p)
	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()
	var _ *os.File
	var _ os.FileInfo
	fi, _ := os.Stat(p)
	_ = os.SameFile(fi, fi)
	_ = os.ErrNotExist
	// os.Remove(p) in a comment is not a call
	_ = "os.Remove"
	var os2 struct{ Remove func() }
	os2.Remove()
}
